caption:
The AI built a change-password form with two plain password inputs. The browser sees two password fields, has to guess which is which, and can drop the saved password into the New field too.

Look at the card. autoComplete tells the password manager what each field is for. current-password means "fill the saved one here". new-password means "don't fill this one, offer to generate a strong password instead".

Use them on every auth form: current-password on login, new-password on signup and reset, and username or email on the email field.

One attribute per input decides whether password managers help your users or get in their way.

Source: MDN, HTML autocomplete attribute.
